short_blurb: Kitchen & bath remodels, room additions, and new construction in Arcadia.
local_note: From updated kitchens and spa-style bathrooms to new ADUs and second-story additions, Palm Crest Builders helps Arcadia homeowners get more from their property. We handle plans, permits through the Arcadia building department, and construction from start to finish — with transparent pricing and a workmanship warranty on every job. We build throughout Arcadia, including Upper Rancho, Highland Oaks, Santa Anita Oaks, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Arcadia?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Arcadia building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Arcadia?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Arcadia rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Arcadia remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
